==About==

Crafting {{i|Rich Marrow Dumplings}} will make an {{i|Unboiled Rich Marrow Dumplings}} which can then be boiled in a {{i|Clay Pot}}, {{i|Copper Pot}}, or {{i|Cauldron}} for 1 hour to produce Rich Marrow Dumplings. Rich Marrow Dumplings takes its [[Purity]] from both the {{i|Any Bones}} and {{i|Flour}} used in its construction.
